notes: BirdDog A200 (also marketed as "Eyes A200", currently shipping as "A200 Gen 2") is an outdoor IP67 PTZ camera with 30x optical zoom, simultaneous SDI + full NDI output. Physical I/O is a 12-lead tail-cable bundle (not a rear jack panel) documented in the official user guide's "Camera Diagrams" page, cross-checked against the current manufacturer tech-spec page (birddog.tv/a200-overview/a200-techspecs). Primary power input is 24VAC via a Phoenix/terminal-block connector (captive tail cable); PoE (BirdDog's 97W PoE injector, optional accessory) is an alternate power path carried over the RJ45 Ethernet lead. SDI output is confirmed 3G-SDI by both the manual and spec sheet. The second BNC (analog/composite output), AUX DC12V output, RS422/RS485 control leads, alarm I/O, and USB upgrade interface all appear in the user-guide connector diagram but are condensed/omitted on the marketing tech-spec page, so their exact wording is guide-sourced. The "Upgrade Interface" connector's precise physical shell (USB-A vs micro-USB) could not be confirmed from the schematic icon alone, so usb-2.0/usb-a is an inference and flagged low-certainty. The RS422 and RS485/RS422 leads (items 3 and 11) are explicitly documented as a matched pair meant to be combined into one control interface; they are represented here as a single bidirectional port with connector rs422 and accepts rs485. Ethernet is confirmed Gigabit (10/100/1000 Mbps) per the manual's cable-requirements section. No rack unit applies (dome PTZ camera, pole/wall/ceiling-mounted, not a rack device).

ports.name: Audio In
ports.note: Stereo 3.5mm audio input (per official tech-spec sheet: '3.5mm Audio In (Stereo)')

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: Stereo 3.5mm audio output (per official tech-spec sheet: '3.5mm Audio Out (Stereo)')

ports.name: Analog Video Output
ports.note: Composite/analog output on tail-cable BNC; used for setup/monitoring, not bandwidth-graded

ports.name: RJ45 Ethernet Port
ports.note: 10/100/1000 Mbps (Gig) port; carries NDI video, control, and PoE (BirdDog 97W PoE injector)

ports.name: RS422/RS485 Connector
ports.note: Two tail-cable pigtails (labeled RS422 and RS485/RS422, meant to be combined) providing VISCA (RS422) / Pelco-D (RS485) serial PTZ control

ports.name: Upgrade Interface
ports.note: Firmware upgrade port; manufacturer spec lists 'Firmware upgrade via USB2.0 or IP' but the pigtail connector's exact physical form (USB-A vs micro/mini) is not confirmed from available imagery

ports.name: Alarm Input
ports.note: Dry-contact alarm input on bare/terminal pigtail leads; closest catalog connector to the flying-lead terminal shown

ports.name: Alarm Output
ports.note: Dry-contact alarm output on bare/terminal pigtail leads

ports.name: AUX DC12V Output
ports.note: Auxiliary 12VDC output for powering accessories, on tail-cable

ports.name: AC Power Connector
ports.note: 24VAC power input terminated via Phoenix-style terminal block connector (per user guide: 'Power Connector: Phoenix Connector Description'); PoE (97W injector, optional) is an alternative power path via the RJ45 port
